_comment: Paths (relative to the scaffolded shop root) to delete when cms === null (--cms=none). propeller-vue ships a CMS engine in src/lib/cms (Strapi + Prepr providers, picked at runtime by CMS_PROVIDER), so --cms=strapi|prepr keeps everything here. A no-CMS shop deletes the CMS-only views: the catch-all CmsPageView, the blog list/detail and the CmsFallback they render; CmsFallback is imported only by those views, so it is dead code once they go. src/lib/cms itself stays: with CMS_PROVIDER=none it is a no-op provider, and the home page and server still import it. The only file that REFERENCES the deleted views is src/router/index.ts (the blog routes + the :slug+ cms-page catch-all), patched surgically by overlay-no-cms/src/router/index.ts.textpatch.json.
